review_candidates.company: İK Kampüsü | İnsan Kaynakları ve Kariyer Danışmanlık Hizmetleri
review_candidates.description: TalentLeader Human Resources Consultancy is looking for an experienced QA / Test Engineer on behalf of our client, with strong expertise in API integration testing, performance testing, and end-to-end test execution. In this role, you will be responsible for validating API parity between different implementations, verifying performance requirements under production-like conditions, and owning User Acceptance Testing (UAT) throughout the migration process. ➡️ Position Details • Start Date: ASAP • Duration: Until 16 April 2027 • Workload: Full-time • Location: Remote ➡️ Key Responsibilities • Design and execute API parity tests by comparing MuleSoft and Quickwork implementations, validating HTTP status codes, response schemas, and semantic equivalence of response bodies. • Develop and maintain API test suites using Postman/Newman and programmatic testing frameworks. • Design and execute performance tests to validate production-like workloads, response times, throughput, and timeout requirements. • Develop comprehensive test scenarios based on OpenAPI 3.0 specifications, covering boundary conditions, equivalence classes, optional and required field combinations, and error scenarios. • Design and implement stateful end-to-end tests for the FPWP business flow: Feasibility → POQ → Order, including token propagation across multiple API requests. • Develop regression test suites to ensure that API migration and cutover activities do not adversely affect existing integrations. • Integrate automated API tests into GitLab CI/CD pipelines, ensuring that failed tests block the relevant pipeline stage. • Own UAT execution, document test evidence and results, and provide clear pass/fail recommendations for formal sign-off. • Collaborate with technical stakeholders and subject matter experts to investigate discrepancies, validate edge cases, and distinguish expected differences from defects. • Prepare synthetic test data aligned with relevant B2B wholesale API schemas without exposing real customer or partner information. ➡️ Required Qualifications and Technical Skills 1️⃣ API Integration and Parity Testing • At least 5 years of experience in API integration testing, including experience with API migration, re-platforming, or parallel implementation scenarios. • Proven ability to validate parity between two implementations of the same API through systematic response comparison. • Strong hands-on experience with Postman and Newman, including collection development, environment configuration, token management, automated execution, and HTML test reporting. • Experience with RestAssured, pytest-requests, or an equivalent programmatic API testing framework. • Understanding of contract testing principles; practical experience with Pact or similar tools is a strong advantage. 2️⃣ Performance Testing • Hands-on experience with JMeter, k6, or Gatling, including baseline measurements, load ramp-up, sustained load testing, and performance result analysis. • Ability to simulate realistic production traffic using concurrent users, representative request mixes, and appropriate think times. • Understanding of application latency, network latency, test harness overhead, cold starts, and throughput limitations. • Ability to identify the root causes of performance degradation and distinguish temporary latency spikes from genuine capacity constraints. • Experience validating strict API timeout requirements under production-like load, including confirming that p99 response times remain below 55 seconds against a 60-second timeout constraint. 3️⃣ Test Design and Automation • Strong knowledge of equivalence partitioning, boundary value analysis, negative testing, and regression test design. • Ability to derive comprehensive test cases from OpenAPI 3.0 specifications, including edge cases beyond the examples explicitly provided. • Experience designing and managing synthetic test data for B2B wholesale API integrations. • Hands-on experience integrating Postman/Newman collections into GitLab CI/CD pipelines, with automated execution and pipeline-blocking failure conditions. 4️⃣ End-to-End Testing and UAT Ownership • Experience designing stateful, multi-step API test scenarios involving token or identifier propagation across requests. • Ability to determine when integration test scenarios require mocked backends and when live UAT integrations are necessary. • Experience owning UAT execution and making evidence-based pass/fail recommendations. • Ability to prepare structured test reports documenting test cases, inputs, expected results, actual results, and pass/fail status. • Strong analytical, documentation, problem-solving, and stakeholder communication skills. ➡️ Nice-to-Have Qualifications • Experience testing TM Forum Open APIs, particularly TMF622, TMF645, and TMF673. • Familiarity with MEF Sonata APIs, including MEF87 POQ and MEF121 Address Validation. • Experience testing Quickwork journeys through API triggers and inspecting execution traces in Quickwork logs. • Practical experience with Pact or other contract testing solutions. • German language skills for communicating test results to internal stakeholders.

review_candidates.title: Project Associate (Cultural Mediator)
review_candidates.description: Job Description Introduction Established in 1951, IOM is a Related Organization of the United Nations and the leading UN agency in the field of migration. Working closely with governmental, intergovernmental and non-governmental partners, IOM promotes humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It saves lives and protects people on the move, drives solutions to displacement, and facilitates pathways for regular migration, while providing services and advice to governments and migrants. IOM is committed to fostering a respectful, inclusive and supportive workplace where all employees can thrive professionally and feel valued. By creating such an environment, IOM aims to better harness the full potential of migration and strengthen its support to people on the move. IOM invites candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply and provides reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process when required. Learn more about IOM’s workplace culture at IOM workplace culture | International Organization for Migration Applications are welcome from internal and external candidates. For all IOM vacancies, applications from qualified and eligible first-tier candidates are considered before those of qualified and eligible second-tier candidates in the selection process. For the purpose of this vacancy, internal and internal-equivalent candidates are considered as first-tier candidates. Organizational Context and Scope Responsibilities Under the overall supervision of the Senior Operations Officer and direct supervision of the Senior Project Associate (Cultural Mediator/Interpretation), the incumbent will be responsible for supporting the implementation of the Assistance Programme by facilitating communication and cultural mediation following functions and responsibilities: Provide interpretation in Dari and/or Pashto and English to facilitate communication between IOM Assistance Programme Staff to communicate with Afghan evacuees at CAS. Accompany guests to appointments or meetings (e.g. medical visits), where required, to provide interpretation/translation support. Carry out informal written translations for the Assistance Programme from English to Dari and/or Pashto (and vice versa), often working to a tight deadline with high standards of accuracy. Maintain the confidentiality and integrity of all relevant paperwork in line with standards of conduct and data protection rules. Apply humanitarian principles in all duties, as well as a gender, age and diversity-sensitive approach. Contribute to strengthening intercultural understanding among Protection/MHPSS and partner staff by organizing and delivering cultural awareness sessions. Provide inputs for daily, quarterly and annual reports through the use of the SMART CAMP SYNC App to track appointments and requests logged by protection/MHPSS staff. Assist the Complaint and Feedback Mechanism team, when required, with interpretation and / or written translation. Perform such other related duties as may be assigned. Qualifications Required Qualifications and Experience Education High school diploma with five years of relevant experience; or, Bachelor’s degree in Political or Social Sciences, International Relations, Development Studies, Migration Studies, Human Rights, Law or related fields from an accredited academic institution with three years of relevant professional experience. Accredited Universities are those listed in the UNESCO World Higher Education Database. Experience Experience working with at-risk community members and individuals with specific needs. Experience in the field of migration, including assistance. Experience working in a transit centre and/or on a resettlement programme. Experience working in a fast-paced, multicultural environment; and Prior interpretation and/or translation experience. Skills Excellent knowledge and skills in translation and interpretation between the target language(s). Demonstrated ability to draft and edit translations in the target language(s). Strong interpersonal and communication skills in a multicultural setting. Strong work ethics and commitment to humanitarian principles. In depth knowledge of the broad range of migration related subject areas dealt within the Organization. Proficiency in Microsoft Office software packages. Availability and flexibility to work beyond the normal working schedule and on day/evening/night shift duties. Languages All IOM staff members in all categories are required to be fluent in one of the IOM's official languages (English, French, Spanish). For this position, fluency in English and Dari or Pashto are required (oral and written). Proficiency of language(s) required will be specifically evaluated during the selection process, which may include written and/or oral assessments. Required Competencies IOM’s competency framework can be found at this link . Competencies will be assessed during the selection process. Values - all IOM staff members must abide by and demonstrate these five values: Inclusion and respect for diversity: Respects and promotes individual and cultural differences. Encourages diversity and inclusion. Integrity and transparency: Maintains high ethical standards and acts in a manner consistent with organizational principles/rules and standards of conduct. Professionalism: Demonstrates ability to work in a composed, competent and committed manner and exercises careful judgment in meeting day-to-day challenges. Courage: Demonstrates willingness to take a stand on issues of importance. Empathy: Shows compassion for others, makes people feel safe, respected and fairly treated. Core Competencies – behavioural indicators Level 1 Teamwork: Develops and promotes effective collaboration within and across units to achieve shared goals and optimize results. Delivering results: Produces and delivers quality results in a service-oriented and timely manner. Is action oriented and committed to achieving agreed outcomes. Managing and sharing knowledge: Continuously seeks to learn, share knowledge and innovate. Accountability: Takes ownership for achieving the Organization’s priorities and assumes responsibility for own actions and delegated work. Communication: Encourages and contributes to clear and open communication. Explains complex matters in an informative, inspiring and motivational way. Notes Please refer to this link for guidance on IOM Job Category. Female candidates are strongly encourage to apply. Any offer made to the candidate in relation to this vacancy notice is subject to funding confirmation. This selection process may be used to staff similar positions in various duty stations. Recommended candidates will remain eligible to be appointed in a similar position for a period of 24 months. Appointment will be subject to certification that the candidate is medically fit for appointment, accreditation, any residency or visa requirements, security clearances. IOM has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and IOM, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination based on gender, nationality, age, race, sexual orientation, religious or ethnic background or disabilities. IOM does not charge a fee at any stage of its recruitment process (application, interview, processing, training or other fee). IOM does not request any information related to bank accounts. IOM only accepts duly completed applications submitted through the IOM e-Recruitment system (for internal candidates link here ). The online tool also allows candidates to track the status of their application. No late applications will be accepted. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. For further information and other job postings, you are welcome to visit our website: IOM Careers and Job Vacancies
